desc: The player's screenshot (TTYD_USER_SHOT, as F12) read back from the picture as shown and saved to the user folder's Photos at the window's size: the read-back answers (no fall back to the 640x480 frame copy, no leaked or late answer); then the Journal's Photos list it (Start, four tabs right, A, up twice, A). (Photo mode's TTYD_PHOTO_TEST says 'not available here' at story 21 on gor_01; not used.)
